test_title: PYST 52: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some cameras are phones.

No phone is a laptop.

Conclusions:

(1) Some phones are cameras.

(II) Some laptops are phones.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55c2b2c5b0bfdf4170abe6e49ec20bec6267b570926fc93d7173438db56c191e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00880b16a00cc355655509d5bda8966988e1430c06ecb27ad589cfe783751281.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(1) Some phones are cameras → **True **(As, Some cameras are phones. so, Some phones are cameras holds true)

(II) Some laptops are phones → False (As, No phone is a laptop. so, Some laptops are phones cannot be a possibility).

Thus, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
